column3: CORRECTED equation: CL(mL/min) = 0.695 x CrCl + 0.05 x weight_kg (NOT flat +0.05 mL/min). Bauer's own worked examples (Ch.5 Examples 1-2, pp.218-221) apply the nonrenal constant on a mL/min/kg basis, scaled by patient weight. The original Stage 8A implementation used a flat +0.05 mL/min regardless of patient size, understating CL by ~5% at CrCl=97 and ~16% at CrCl=25 for a 70kg patient. Caught via Stage 21 validation against Bauer's own worked examples; corrected version reproduces both examples to within 0.4% error.
